scenes.narration: In mice, five hours awake reduced dendritic spines: the receiving side of excitatory connections.
scenes.main_point: In mice, sleep loss reduces dendritic spines on hippocampal neurons.
scenes.visual_objective: See a CA1 neuron, a magnified dendrite, what a spine and synapse are, and spines disappearing.
